ruleDefinitions.name: Read Contents From Stdin Via Cmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect the use of "<" to read and potentially execute a file via cmd.exe

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\<.*"))
